question: prof mandel and prof skowronski - which one is in the business school? need a minor advisor
answer:
Both are in the Anisfield School of Business: Mark Skowronski is Associate Professor of Management [1], and Patti Mandel is Lecturer of Marketing [2].

For a minor, the Center for Student Success (Academic Advising) says to consult your advisor, get the minor convener’s signature on the form, and return the signed form to the Office of the Registrar; do this within a reasonable time before graduation [3]. Declared students are assigned a faculty advisor within their specific school at the beginning of their second year [4]. To find your current advisor, check Connect under My Success Network; if the advisor is not listed, contact your school’s main office [5]. Anisfield School of Business Office: ASB-333, (201) 684-7378 [4, 7].
